Presidential Decree No. 85 dated December 24, 1972 is hereby repealed and all other laws, executive orders,
rule sand regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with this Decree are likewise repealed or modified
accordingly.
This decree shall take effect upon its approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
